'''Simona Berman''', also credited as '''Rebecca Becker''', is a voice actress for the English-language [[dub]] of {{aniseries|PTS}}. She is currently affiliated with Stewart Talent Agency.

==Biography==
Little is known about Berman's early life, other than she became a voice actress as an adult. She started her career with the {{pkmn|animated series}} during {{aniseries|SM}}. She played [[Mimo]], {{an|Kiawe}}'s younger sister; and the {{p|Charjabug}} species, most notably [[Sophocles's Charjabug]].
